summary: This Form 6-K filed by Ericsson discloses weekly share buybacks under a previously announced SEK 15B program running from April 23, 2026 to March 31, 2027. In the week ended May 8, 2026, Ericsson repurchased 2,650,000 Class B shares at a weighted-average price of SEK 110.19 per share, for total SEK 292M. The Board intends to propose cancellation of repurchased shares (excluding those for incentive plans) to the 2027 AGM. The buyback is conducted under EU MAR Safe Harbour via Goldman Sachs on Nasdaq Stockholm. Treasury now holds 46,763,592 Class B shares out of total outstanding 3,371,351,735 shares. This is an ongoing capital return program.
